en.name: Alternating knee lifts
en.subtitle: Teacher-marked movement · Primary 1–3
steps: Stand facing the camera with space around you. Move at your teacher's pace.
Lift one knee a little, only as high as feels comfortable. Keep the other foot down.
Put that foot down and stand on both feet again.
Lift the other knee a little. Alternate sides without hopping.
en.focus: Teacher marks one lift and return as one attempt; check that sides alternate.

zh-Hant.name: 交替提膝
zh-Hant.subtitle: 老師記錄動作 · 小一至小三
steps: 面向鏡頭站立，身旁留出空間，跟著老師的速度活動。
輕輕提起一邊膝蓋，提到舒適的高度，另一隻腳留在地上。
把腳放下，回到雙腳站立。
輕輕提起另一邊膝蓋，左右交替，不要跳躍。
zh-Hant.focus: 老師把一次提膝及放下記作一次，並留意左右交替。
